title: Riding Door County in November
why: November e-bike renters: timing, layers, deer season safety, where to ride.
hook_options: How to ride Door County in November.
Bare trees, empty roads, loud lake.
caption: November in Door County: bare trees, empty roads and a lake with an attitude. Ride midday (sunset's before 5), dress 10 degrees colder than the forecast, and wear something bright during gun deer season, Nov 21 to 29. #DoorCounty #CavePoint #EBike #NovemberInWisconsin

slides.headline: November is a different ride.
slides.body: Bare trees, empty roads and a lake that gets gray and loud. Here's how to do it right.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-point-winter-caves-and-ice-castles.jpg

slides.headline: Ride between 11 and 2.
slides.body: Clocks fall back Nov 1 and sunset is before 5 all month. Midday is the warmest part of the day.

slides.headline: Dress for 10 degrees colder.
slides.body: Lake wind plus 20 mph of riding. Windproof shell, real gloves, a thin hat and closed-toe shoes.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Ice castles ebike tour photos/Cave-point-ebike-tour-photo-shoot2.jpg

slides.headline: Nov 21 to 29: wear something bright.
slides.body: That's Wisconsin's gun deer season. Blaze orange or any bright layer helps drivers and hunters see you.

slides.headline: Roads and park paths, not the woods.
slides.body: Hunting is allowed in open areas of Whitefish Dunes State Park starting Nov 15. Stick to marked routes.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0655.JPG

slides.headline: The roads are basically yours.
slides.body: Summer traffic is long gone. It's you, the cedars and the lake.

slides.headline: Cave Point when the lake is angry.
slides.body: On windy days the waves slam the cliffs. Watch from the top and stay off wet rock.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-County-Park-E-Bike-Tour-Rental.jpg

slides.headline: Get the whole family outside.
slides.body: Relatives in town Friday? Check the booking calendar and get everyone riding before dark.

slides.headline: Midday. Layers. Something bright.
slides.body: Ride the roads, skip the woods, and watch the waves from the top.

slides.kicker: Save this for a November weekend
slides.headline: Ride it before the snow does.
slides.body: E-bike rentals at doorcountykayaktours.com. Send this to whoever's hosting Thanksgiving.
